author: Dr Ben Miles
description:
Scientists have developed a brain implant that decodes both speech and gestures simultaneously by interpreting neural signals from the sensorimotor cortex. This technology uses machine learning to translate brain activity into text and animated gestures, enabling real-time communication for individuals with severe paralysis.

Source Article: https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-02895-6
